basic_details.job_title: NLU Delhi Counsellor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Law University Delhi (NLU Delhi) is filling one full-time Counsellor position on a contract of one year, extendable subject to satisfactory performance, at a consolidated remuneration of Rs.75,000/- per month (TDS @10% will be deducted). Applicants need a Master's Degree in Psychology / Counselling / Applied Psychology / Clinical Psychology / Psychiatric Social Work and at least 3 years of relevant experience. Apply only online at careers.nludelhi.ac.in by 7 December 2026, 11:59 p.m.

how_to_apply: Open the application form at the University's careers portal, https://careers.nludelhi.ac.in.
Submit the application through that online form only. Physical or email applications will not be considered.
Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs.1,000/- online. SC/ST and PwD candidates are exempted from the fee.
Submit the application by 7th December, 2026 at 11:59 p.m.

The notice does not list the documents to be uploaded with the form. Updates, if any, will be published only on the University website, www.nludelhi.ac.in. For queries, the notice gives the email [email protected], but states that no interim queries will be entertained.
important_instructions: NLU Delhi reserves the right not to fill the positions advertised. The selected applicant has to submit a Non-Disclosure Agreement at the time of joining NLU Delhi. NLU Delhi describes itself as an equal opportunity employer. No interim queries will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: About NLU Delhi
content_sections.text: National Law University Delhi is a law university at Sector 14, Dwarka, New Delhi. According to the notice, it was established in 2008 on the initiative of the High Court of Delhi and the Govt. of NCT of Delhi. It offers the five-year integrated B.A.LL.B.(Hons.) Programme, LL.M. (Regular), Joint Masters/LL.M. in IP Law and Management Programme, Post Graduate in Insolvency Program (PGIP), Ph.D. and other diploma programmes. The Counsellor post is meant to strengthen its student well-being and mental health support services.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The University invites applications from qualified and experienced professionals. The notice sets these essential qualifications. Master's Degree in Psychology / Counselling / Applied Psychology / Clinical Psychology / Psychiatric Social Work from a recognized university. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in counselling students, youth, or professionals in an institutional setting. Experience in integrated counselling, trauma management, intervention therapy, or mental health education. Familiarity with issues of student adjustment, stress management, and relationship and career counselling. Excellent interpersonal, communication, and documentation skills. The notice lists these areas of competence: Foundational (CBT, REBT, Person-Centered Therapy); Integrative (Mindfulness, Trauma-Informed Care, Solution-Focused); Applied (Crisis Intervention, behavioral Activation, IPT). Meeting the eligibility criteria does not guarantee an interview or a final offer.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is Rs.75,000/- per month, with TDS @10% deducted. The appointment is contractual for one year and further extendable subject to satisfactory performance. The notice adds that candidates with higher qualifications may be considered for higher remuneration than the minimum prescribed.

content_sections.heading: NLU Delhi Counsellor Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide individual and group counselling to students and staff. Conduct workshops and awareness programs on mental health and emotional well-being. Maintain confidential records and case documentation. Collaborate with faculty, administration, and external experts to support the University's wellness ecosystem. Any other tasks assigned by the University.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NLU Delhi Counsellor
content_sections.text: Open the application form at the University's careers portal, https://careers.nludelhi.ac.in . Submit the application through that online form only. Physical or email applications will not be considered. Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs.1,000/- online. SC/ST and PwD candidates are exempted from the fee. Submit the application by 7th December, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. The notice does not list the documents to be uploaded with the form. Updates, if any, will be published only on the University website, www.nludelhi.ac.in . For queries, the notice gives the email [email protected] , but states that no interim queries will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted based on an assessment of the application documents submitted through the online form. Only shortlisted candidates are called for the further selection process, and only those selected for the interview are contacted. If a candidate does not hear from the University within 4 weeks after the deadline, the application should be assumed unsuccessful. The interview date and mode are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: NLU Delhi reserves the right not to fill the positions advertised. The selected applicant has to submit a Non-Disclosure Agreement at the time of joining NLU Delhi. NLU Delhi describes itself as an equal opportunity employer. No interim queries will be entertained.
